messages:
Maria: quick heads-up — FP8 enablement on H100/L40S showing quality dip on long-tail prompts in latest canary. attaching quick notes.
Sahil: how big? numbers? :eyes:
Maria: overall perplexity +0.9 on eval set; tail (len>1024) token-F1 down ~4.2% vs fp32 baseline. small samples in s3.
Jordan: is this the kv-tiling change from last week or activation-scaler mismatch?
Olivia: saw similar with AWQ but smaller. suspect activation-flooring when seq reuse occurs. fp8 dynamic scale heuristics differ by kernel.
Ethan: paste kernel config? I'll repro locally.
Maria: config:
```
--kernel=fp8_autorange
--tiling=kv_backoff
--quant-mode=fp8
--act-scale=dynamic_per_head
--seq-threshold=1024
```
Sahil: try act-scale=static_channel and rerun 100 tail samples.
Maria: running. L40S logs showed NaN spikes in layernorm warmup:
```
layernorm: scale=nan count=3 at step 47
kv_cache_write: overwrote offsets 0->64
```
Jordan: NaNs could be kernel handshake when partial fp32 fallback gets invoked. add safety clamp during warmup.
Olivia: add epsilon floor in activation scaler + stable kv pointer restore; AWQ/GPTQ patches had this.
Ethan: A/Bing now: fp8_autorange vs fp8_static_channel on H100 canary (50 tail prompts). will share results.
qa-bot: Shadow run queued: job 1729. ETA ~18m.
Maria: if token-F1 delta >2% on tail, block canary promotion. tagging rollout gating.
Sahil: agree. add routing rule: fallback to int8 for seq >2048 until triage.
Jordan: infra: surface fallback path metrics in console per-route so ops see cost impact.
Ethan: results: fp8_static_channel reduced F1 delta to 1.1%, no NaNs, latency +3ms median. csv: s3://redwood-experiments/fp8/2529876543/results.csv
Maria: can we run INT8/GPTQ baseline on same set for tradeoffs?
Olivia: will run GPTQ (8-bit per-row) and AWQ on L40S overnight to check long-context drift.
Maria: action items:
- Maria: finish int8/gptq comparison by EOD tomorrow
- Ethan: PR to add act-scale static_channel toggle + epsilon clamp
- Sahil: add routing fallback rule for long sequences
- Jordan: ensure per-route fallback cost metrics in console
- Olivia: run AWQ/GPTQ on tail prompts
Maria: pinging @deploy-bot when PRs merge for canary with clamp.
deploy-bot: noted — will run canary after PRs merged and tests pass.
Sahil: doc request: add kernel handshake invariants to fp8 runbook (kv offset wrap edge-case).
Maria: adding short triage note to wiki.
Ethan: will update thread with final numbers. :thumbsup:
